ponyta-flame-charge.name: Flame Charge
ponyta-flame-charge.description: Bond skill: gallops up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 55, Attack) and engages it.

ponyta-flare-blitz.name: Flare Blitz
ponyta-flare-blitz.description: Bond skill: a blazing charge (Power 100, Attack) that Burns the foe for 2 turns.

ponyta-fire-blast.name: Fire Blast
ponyta-fire-blast.description: Bond skill: a star of fire up to 3 hexes away (Power 100, Sp. Atk) that Burns the foe 2 turns.

ponyta-flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
ponyta-flash-fire.description: Cannot be Burned; its Fire moves deal 10% more damage.

ponyta-run-away.name: Run Away
ponyta-run-away.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

ponyta-horn-attack.name: Horn Attack
ponyta-horn-attack.description: New skill: jabs the foe with its sharp horn (Power 55).

ponyta-flame-body.name: Flame Body
ponyta-flame-body.description: Its hits on adjacent foes Burn them for 1 turn.

ponyta-galloping.name: Galloping Hooves
ponyta-galloping.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

ponyta-flame-wheel.name: Flame Wheel
ponyta-flame-wheel.description: New skill: rolls into the foe wreathed in fire (Power 60), Burning it for 1 turn.

ponyta-incinerate.name: Incinerate
ponyta-incinerate.description: New skill: a burst of flame up to 1 hex away (Power 60) hitting a 1-hex area.

ponyta-pace-setter.name: Pace Setter
ponyta-pace-setter.description: Gives the team 1 Bond when it lands a combo.

ponyta-inferno.name: Inferno
ponyta-inferno.description: New skill: engulfs a foe up to 2 hexes away in fire (Power 90), Burning it for 3 turns.

ponyta-extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
ponyta-extreme-speed.description: New skill: dashes at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80) and engages it.

ponyta-unicorn-horn.name: Unicorn Horn
ponyta-unicorn-horn.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

ponyta-blazing-aura.name: Blazing Aura
ponyta-blazing-aura.description: Takes 10% less damage: its burning mane keeps foes at bay.

ponyta-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
ponyta-double-edge.description: New skill: a reckless full-gallop charge into the foe (Power 95).

ponyta-overheat.name: Overheat
ponyta-overheat.description: New skill: unleashes all its heat at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

ponyta-wildfire-run.name: Trail of Embers
ponyta-wildfire-run.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 more turn.

ponyta-second-wind.name: Second Wind
ponyta-second-wind.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

ponyta-rapid-blaze.name: Blazing Stampede
ponyta-rapid-blaze.description: Capstone. Nothing holds it back: cannot be Slowed or Paralysed; deals 10% more damage.

ponyta-wildfire.name: Wildfire
ponyta-wildfire.description: Capstone. A knockout resets its skill cooldowns; deals 20% more to Burned foes.

ponyta-full-gallop.name: Full Gallop
ponyta-full-gallop.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

ponyta-growl.name: Growl
ponyta-growl.description: New skill: a fierce whinny leaves an adjacent foe Weakened for 2 turns.
